brand.name: Sevakendra
brand.concept: Empowering citizen services, team productivity, and direct community portal management through a lightning-fast live CMS & admin command center.
brand.core_aesthetic: Energetic Swiss High-Contrast meets Warm Indian Tech Modernism — vibrant saffron orange (#EA580C / #F97316) and amber yellow (#EAB308 / #FBBF24) accents balanced with crisp obsidian carbon and warm alabaster stone surfaces.

rules.caption: font-medium text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand tagline + primary quick service access left, live CMS dynamic page preview & verified stats right
entry_surfaces./login: single branded mobile-first auth panel — phone + password credential form, role detection badge, instant admin/user routing
entry_surfaces./admin/setup: high-trust initial first-admin initialization card — single-time setup badge, 10-digit mobile number, admin name, strong password creation
entry_surfaces./user/dashboard: warm user welcome portal — personalized profile header, interactive link cards grid, notice board, and quick service search
entry_surfaces./admin/dashboard: dense management command center — overview analytics metrics, real-time user management table, dynamic CMS page builder, quick links organizer, site settings panel

public_site.header: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/85 dark:bg-stone-900/85 border-b border-stone-200/80 px-4 md:px-8 py-3.5) with Brand Logo, Dynamic Admin-Created Navigation Pages, Quick Links dropdown, and 'Login / Access Portal' CTA.
public_site.hero_section: Asymmetric Bento Hero (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 items-center pt-8 pb-12): Left col-span-7 with dynamic headline, subtitle, quick search, and CTA; Right col-span-5 with interactive status card & live team preview.
public_site.quick_links_grid: Bento Cards Grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5) with tactile hover states, category pill badges, and direct external/internal click-through.
public_site.dynamic_pages_renderer: Route /p/:slug rendering clean markdown/HTML formatted pages with breadcrumbs, last-modified timestamp, print/share tool, and sidebar of related links.

admin_dashboard.structure: Fixed/collapsible responsive Sidebar (w-64 bg-stone-950 text-stone-100 flex flex-col justify-between) + Main Content Area with top utility bar (Role chip, Search, Logout, Quick View Public Site).
admin_dashboard.density: High Density Mode B: Compact table rows (py-2.5), inline action badges, quick search & filter bar, modal dialogs for create/edit/reset-password actions.

user_portal.structure: Clean card-oriented dashboard with warm greeting (e.g. 'Namaste, {name}'), user mobile number badge, active quick links grid with search, and personal profile update modal.

key_features_to_implement: First-Admin One-Time Setup: Automatic detection if no admin exists; prompts /admin/setup with Name, 10-digit Indian Mobile Number (+91 format ready), Password.
Unified Authentication: Single /login page accepting Mobile + Password, validates session cookies via httpOnly, dynamically redirects to /admin/dashboard or /user/dashboard.

User Management System: Admin can create new user logins (Mobile, Name, Password, Role: user, Status: active/inactive), edit details, toggle active status, reset password, and delete accounts with confirmation dialog.
CMS Dynamic Pages Manager: Admin can create/edit/delete public pages (Title, Slug, Excerpt, Content/Body, Show in Navigation Bar Toggle, Display Order).
Public Navigation Integration: Public header dynamically queries and renders pages that have `show_in_nav: true` sorted by `order`.
Quick Links Manager: Admin can add/edit/delete external/internal links with Title, URL, Category/Description, Icon, and Visibility toggle.
Live Site Settings: Admin can configure Site Name, Tagline, Hero Title, Contact Helpline / WhatsApp Number, Support Email, and Announcement Banner.
Indian Mobile & Locale Support: Phone validation for 10-digit Indian numbers (e.g., 9876543210), IST timestamps format (DD MMM YYYY, hh:mm A), Rupee symbol where applicable.

micro_interactions.page_transition: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 8 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.25 }

motion.accessibility_reduced_motion: All motion hooks wrapped with prefers-reduced-motion fallback (instant opacity toggle instead of slide).

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens pass WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 on body, 3:1 on large headings).
accessibility.touch_targets: Mobile-friendly touch targets with minimum 44px x 44px for buttons, inputs, and tab triggers.
accessibility.data_testids: Strict data-testid usage across all interactive controls (e.g. data-testid='login-mobile-input', data-testid='admin-create-user-btn', etc.)

hero_team_banner.description: Collaborative digital team working together on laptops

service_center_building.description: Modern digital service center corporate glass facade

team_collaboration.description: Team members in an energetic planning session

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts: FastAPI backend (`backend/`) + Vite/React 19 frontend (`frontend/src`).
Implement seed data in `backend/seed.py` with initial default site settings, default public pages (e.g. 'About Sevakendra', 'Citizen Services', 'Help & FAQs'), and sample quick links.
Implement auth logic in `backend/routers/auth.py` and manage session with httpOnly cookie token verification or session endpoint `/api/auth/me`.
Ensure one-time first admin registration at `/api/auth/setup` which is disabled immediately once an admin user exists.
Provide comprehensive data-testid tags on all forms, inputs, tables, buttons, and navigation links.
Include responsive mobile navigation menu drawer (Sheet component) for seamless mobile browser browsing.
